author: bardic-inspiration
name: Bandit Warlord
summary: A scarred road-king who rallies a bandit army with a shout and hews through guard lines.
description: A warlord rules a stretch of road and forest the way a baron rules a barony, with tolls, taxes, and justice delivered at the end of an axe. Their followers are loyal because the warlord has never yet lost a fight that mattered.

traits.name: Brutal Cleave
traits.text: When the warlord reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack, it can make one Greataxe attack against another creature within 5 feet of the first as a {ref:glossary/bonus-action}.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The warlord makes three Greataxe attacks.

bonusActions.name: Rally the Pack
bonusActions.text: Each ally of the warlord's choice within 30 feet that can see or hear it gains 10 {ref:glossary/temporary-hit-points} and can make one weapon attack as a {ref:glossary/reaction}.
